scope.supports: In a three-status ledger model (statuses open / control-only / discharged are this node's vocabulary; the register labels each obligation OPEN) with end-to-end DEFINED as all five discharged: by definition the end-to-end claim holds iff every obligation is discharged, equivalently iff every obligation has a control and none is control-only (general over Fin n, instance n=5; Lean); because ControlOnly and Discharged are distinct statuses, a ledger in which every obligation has a passing control and the end-to-end claim fails exists (the register sentence that scoped controls do not discharge has no Lean declaration); one undischarged obligation blocks the claim; replacing position k of the all-Discharged vector by s gives an end-to-end ledger iff s = Discharged (update_sharp), and a monotone raise of the one undischarged position of a ledger completes it (raise_completes); monotone updates never undo the claim; exactly 1 of the 3^5 = 243 vectors is end-to-end (enforced by the checker over the full public input). Source declarations at general scope: the five-flag Boolean AND is the conjunction; the symmetrised adjacency adj u v || adj v u of a finite window is false iff adj u v and adj v u are both false, and windows with opposite orientation have the same symmetrisation (n=2 countermodel), with no source-to-WDP transition map constructed (that is O02); for all naturals q>0 and p, p*p <> 2*q*q (the source witness checks only q in 1..4, p in 1..6), the arithmetic core of GEN-WDP-68, not progress on O04. The columns upgrades, completing_upgrades, prefix_order and node_reading of the table are native definitions without Lean counterparts.
scope.does_not_support: That any of O01..O05 is discharged, dischargeable or refutable; the truth of any end-to-end bridge claim; any independent semantics of "end-to-end" beyond the definitional conjunction; that the register status of O01..O05 is control-only: the register labels each OPEN, and Open/ControlOnly/Discharged and the all-ControlOnly vector 11111 are this node's reading of the node statement (scoped controls done, end-to-end not); that no_sq_eq_two_sq bears on O04; the programme order as a logical dependency; Hilbert, Born, scalar or governance choices; any physical or institutional interpretation.
scope.narrowest_claim: In a three-status ledger model in which end-to-end is defined as all five discharged, scoped controls passing for all five obligations do not make the end-to-end claim hold, which holds exactly when all five are discharged; the node reading (all five control-only) is therefore not end-to-end; ledger bookkeeping only, no obligation is discharged.
scope.next_test: For O02, the only concrete candidate map in hand is the symmetrised adjacency of a finite window: choose an orientation-sensitive source transition system on FiniteGenesisWindow and prove or refute that wdpPairDefect is a preservation-and-reflection morphism for it (pairDefect_forgets_orientation already refutes it for orientation-sensitive transitions); record the outcome as the first falsifier on the O02 row.
